status_model.declared: documented intent only (E0); no schema, version or task evidence
status_model.structural: schema/manifest/version present and statically verified (E1); no live runtime task
status_model.runtime: real runtime task executed with artifact + exit code (E2/E3); evidence fields populated
status_model.missing: tool not installed / capability unsupported; never advertised as available
